repository.name: @webex/plugin-memberships
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.memberships that manages Webex memberships (a person's relationship to a room) through the Webex REST API memberships resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a membership, get and remove take a membership object or id, list resolves a webex-core Page, and update PUTs the whole membership object, which also sets isModerator or hides a one-to-one space through isRoomHidden. listWithReadStatus({roomId}) waits for the current user and the postauth service catalog, reads the conversation with every participant's acknowledgement from the internal conversation plugin, and resolves {items} with one membership per participant carrying lastSeenId and lastSeenDate when the member has seen the space. updateLastSeen(message) sends a read receipt through the conversation acknowledge call and resolves the updated membership. listen() builds a webhook-style event envelope, connects the Mercury socket, and turns conversation activities into created, updated, deleted, and seen events on webex.memberships. Importing the package also registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins. Nothing is cached or persisted.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-memberships package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers the internal plugins conversation and mercury, then Memberships as public plugin 'memberships' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export Memberships is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.memberships methods and events
public_interfaces.audience: applications and the workspace samples browser-socket and browser-read-status
public_interfaces.notes: create, get, list, update, and remove send one hydra memberships request each; list resolves a webex-core Page and remove resolves undefined on 204. No method validates its argument, so a missing argument throws synchronously instead of rejecting. listWithReadStatus takes only roomId and resolves {items}, one per participant, not paged. updateLastSeen takes a message with id and roomId and sends a read receipt. listen() needs spark:all and spark:kms; each call adds another Mercury listener. onWebexApiEvent and getMembershipEvent are marked @private.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not build Hydra ids by hand or with a fixed cluster.
negative_guidance.why: Read-status, read-receipt, and event ids must match the ids the memberships resource returns (INV-001).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not let getMembershipEvent or onWebexApiEvent throw.
negative_guidance.why: They run inside the Mercury listener chain; getMembershipEvent logs and returns null on error (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not fill an event without deep-cloning the stored envelope.
negative_guidance.why: One envelope is shared by every event (INV-003).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log person emails, display names, or ids through webex.logger.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users and spaces; only the conversion error is logged today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: It shows only get(id); see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold or a unit-test command for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No unit test, test:unit script, coverage script, or threshold exists.
